title: Ferritin myth flip — Nadia, 38, 'normal labs' but empty tank
caption:
Myth: 'normal labs' means your iron is fine. Ferritin — the iron-storage test — can be low while a CBC looks normal (Clinical Medicine, 2021).
Send this to your always-tired friend. Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#ferritin #irondeficiency #womenshealth #fatigue #heavyperiods

scenes.text: Always *exhausted*, but told your labs came back normal.

scenes.text: Nadia sleeps nine hours and still wakes up *empty*, every single morning.
phrases: Two kids, late standups, heavy periods.
She started wondering if she was just *lazy*.
She wasn't — nobody had checked her iron stores.

scenes.text: A CBC checks your *hemoglobin*; ferritin checks the iron you have stored.
phrases: The gap has a name: *iron deficiency without anemia*.
It is measurable — one ferritin test (Clinical Medicine, 2021).

scenes.text: Ask for *ferritin*, pair iron-rich food with vitamin C, and move on the easy days.
phrases: 1. Ask: "Can you check my *ferritin*, not just a CBC?"
2. Eat lentils or spinach with citrus — vitamin C boosts iron absorption (NIH ODS).
3. Build toward 150 minutes of gentle movement a week (WHO).
Then let your clinician read the numbers with you.
